commit_message: Close managed runtime failure repair gaps
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0131 first-release agent contracts
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0131 first-release completion by closing runtime failure paths that could enter Repairing without a failed completion gate. Frame-capture failures are now host-owned completion evidence, evaluator launch/exit/poll/unresolved failures fail visual evaluation through the existing AgentHost gate contract, and autonomous runtime repair considers frame-capture failure explicitly.

This preserves the existing managed Play/frame/evaluate/repair architecture, keeps provider reporting unable to forge host-owned frame evidence, and adds regression coverage for frame-capture-driven repair.
